The securities report states that at "Anrakutei" it worked on strengthening the "Meat Day Campaign" held around the 29th of each month, selling the "& (And) Yakiniku Series," and selling the branded wagyu "Matsusaka beef" only at its stores, and at "Shichirinbo" it focused on seasonal fairs and selling new banquet courses.
